# Vendored React Bits components

Copied (unmodified) from https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits — "MIT + Commons Clause", which permits
use as part of an application/website (we do not resell or redistribute the components themselves).

- SpotlightCard — pointer-reactive spotlight on snack cards
- ShinyText — shimmering hero accent
- Magnet — magnetic CTA buttons
- ClickSpark — celebratory sparks on correct answers / completed tasks
- BlurText (local) — React Bits-style blur-in headline re-implemented on GSAP SplitText, see ../../components/BlurText.jsx
